messages.content:
Your board reads as japandi, minimalist, wabi sabi: A calm, earthy Japandi look pairing moss-green upholstery and warm walnut wood with soft cream neutrals, woven textures and minimal low-profile furniture.

Carpentry Feature Wall
  - floor-to-ceiling dark walnut vertical slat wood panel feature wall behind bed
    HDB: allowed, no permit. carpentry fixed to walls (wardrobes, feature walls, solid timber/mirror wall panels, shelves) (HDB-CARPENTRY, https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/renovation-and-maintenance/renovation/renovation-guidelines/building-works)
      - Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration depth
      - Ferrolite walls: at most 50kg per bolt, bolts at most 50mm long, drill depth about 22mm, no drilling within 200mm below ceilings/beams
      - Do not cover the kitchen sanitary-duct weephole
      - Household shelter: see HDB-HS

Sofa
  - Owen II 3 Seater Sofa (S$1,499.00 landed) - Low-profile three-seater with loose-cushion look; delivered S$1,499 fits cap. Colour unlisted, so confirm sage/olive linen option.
    https://www.castlery.com/sg/products/owen-ii-3-seater-sofa
      cheaper comparable: SALTMYRAN 3-seat sofa, Modern grey sofa, SALTMYRAN, sleek de (ikea_sg), S$284.00 landed
      cheaper comparable: [SAMPLE] Japandi 3-seater linen sofa, low back, oak legs (taobao), S$621.80 landed [SAMPLE DATA, not a real offer]

Coffee Table
  - UGGLERUM Coffee table, UGGLERUM Coffee table, walnut veneer, 130x65 cm (S$209.00 landed (est.)) - Walnut veneer coffee table at S$199, well under cap; warm mid-wood tone fits the Japandi palette.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/ugglerum-coffee-table-walnut-veneer-80627979/

Rug
  - ÄRENDE Rug, high pile, A light beige, rectangular, shaggy rug with soft, thick p (S$114.90 landed (est.)) - Light beige high-pile shaggy rectangular rug, 160x230 cm, soft thick pile; S$114.90 delivered, well under cap.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/aerende-rug-high-pile-off-white-90614976/

Bed Frame
  - SLATTUM Upholstered bed frame, Modern bed: SLATTUM, black, fabric, rectangular,  (S$134.00 landed (est.)) - Fabric-upholstered padded headboard in soft neutral grey; low-profile and closest to an upholstered surround.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/slattum-upholstered-bed-frame-vissle-dark-grey-60571252/

Pendant Light
  - SJÖMAKT Pendant lamp, An SJÖMAKT pendant lamp, cream-colored, with a metallic sh (S$49.90 landed (est.)) - Cream/beige shade with wood detail suits the off-white, natural Japandi palette; the closest to a woven look.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/sjoemakt-pendant-lamp-beige-ash-80595681/

Side Table
  - Mori C-Side Table (S$288.00 landed) - Low-profile C-shaped side table suits minimalist Japandi; listed S$269 is under cap, though not woven.
    https://www.castlery.com/sg/products/mori-c-side-table
      cheaper comparable: BRUKSVARA Side table, White BRUKSVARA side table with rectan (ikea_sg), S$23.90 landed
      cheaper comparable: UGGLERUM Side table, UGGLERUM Side table, brown, 46x40 cm (ikea_sg), S$109.90 landed

Table Lamp
  - ÅRSTID Table lamp, ÅRSTID brass lamp with white shade, classic design, steel bas (S$39.90 landed (est.)) - Brass steel base with white textured shade; closest to brass dome look, slim classic stem, affordable.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/arstid-table-lamp-brass-white-30321373/

Floor Lamp
  - SKAFTET Floor lamp base, arched, SKAFTET black floor lamp with arched design, co (S$125.00 landed (est.)) - Black slim arched metal floor lamp base, minimal; S$125 delivered, within cap.
    https://www.ikea.com/sg/en/p/skaftet-floor-lamp-base-arched-black-70405525/

Selected basket total: S$2,340.70 (landed SGD, delivery charged once per retailer, GST included). Your furniture budget is S$6,000.00; remaining: S$3,659.30.

Works still requiring clarification (not cleared to proceed):
  - warm mid-brown wood plank or vinyl flooring with natural grain (mixed): Confirm the room for this work before checking its HDB route.

items.description: low three-seater sofa in sage olive green linen with loose back cushions and dark slim base
modular tufted green velvet sofa with chunky rounded blocks and ottoman
oval walnut coffee table with tapered splayed legs and nesting lower bench-like tier
cream white high-pile shaggy rug, large rectangular
low platform bed with rounded upholstered beige fabric surround and wide headboard
floor-to-ceiling dark walnut vertical slat wood panel feature wall behind bed
cluster of three woven wood slatted dome pendant lamps in varying heights
large white matte dome pendant lamp, oversized half-sphere shade
low woven seagrass round floor cushion seats, flat straw pouf
brass dome shade small table lamp with slim stem
black arched slim metal floor reading lamp with angled cone shade
warm mid-brown wood plank or vinyl flooring with natural grain

conditions: No raising the floor as a platform

conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes

options.reason: Laying or replacing parquet/timber (laminated, bamboo) flooring needs no permit when it goes over the existing finishes without a platform, cement screed or hacking.
options.route: Overlay: laying parquet/timber/laminate/bamboo over existing finishes
conditions: No raising the floor as a platform
No cement screed
No hacking/removal of existing floor finishes
Flats without existing finishes: finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.

options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.route: Overlay: laying parquet/timber/laminate/bamboo over existing finishes
conditions: No raising the floor as a platform

routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.
verdict.route: Replace: block completed 3 or more years ago
conditions: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Water test after replacing the floor finishes

options.reason: New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction.
options.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

suggestions.verdict_reason: Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.

routes.reason: New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction.
routes.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.
routes.route: Replace: block completed 3 or more years ago
conditions: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Water test after replacing the floor finishes

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying or replacing parquet/timber (laminated, bamboo) flooring needs no permit when it goes over the existing finishes without a platform, cement screed or hacking.
options.route: Overlay: laying parquet/timber/laminate/bamboo over existing finishes
conditions: No raising the floor as a platform
No cement screed
No hacking/removal of existing floor finishes
Flats without existing finishes: finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: No raising the floor as a platform

routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only

UPVC floor trap grating with long collar

verdict.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.
verdict.route: Replace: block completed 3 or more years ago
conditions: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Water test after replacing the floor finishes

options.reason: New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction.
options.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom
